run_ruff_linter_cli: run the ruff linter CLI on Python files with config, explain, and auto-fix options
run_check_files: run ruff check on a list of Python files and return LintMessage objects with severities
run_check_file_for_fixes: run ruff check --fix-only on a single file and return a LintMessage with the diff
create_LintMessage: create a LintMessage dataclass with path, line, code, severity, and description fields
run_run_command: run a subprocess command with retry logic, timeout, and logging support
